what_changed: FCC announces December 15, 2025 as the effective date of 47 CFR 64.1200(o), requiring all voice service providers (not only gateway providers) to block calls from numbers on a reasonable do-not-originate list.
rationale: Blocking duty falls on voice providers; a lender or collector is affected only if it spoofs an invalid or inbound-only number, which the diff does not change for callers. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
